pois.name: Skandinavium
pois.description: Indoor arena in Gothenburg, opened in 1971. Hosts concerts, sports events, and entertainment.

pois.name: Gothia Towers
pois.description: Landmark hotel complex next to Liseberg in central Gothenburg. Modern architecture with distinctive twin towers.

pois.name: Museum of Art
pois.description: Art museum with collections from the 15th century to contemporary works. Located at Götaplatsen.

pois.name: Poseidon Statue
pois.description: Statue of Poseidon at Götaplatsen. The statue is a symbol of Gothenburg and is a popular tourist attraction.
